name: Conical Bowl with Carved Babies and Floral Motif
material: Porcelain with pale bluish-white glaze, qingbai ("blue-white") ware
dimensions: Overall: 7.8 x 20.3 cm (3 1/16 x 8 in.); Diameter: 21.6 cm (8 1/2 in.)
summary: The conical shape of this bowl is especially suitable for whipping powdered tea, which became popular at court, in monasteries, and in scholarly elite circles during the Southern Song dynasty.
